answer.reason: Genesis tells what happened in Eden: the LORD God planted a garden there and put the man in it, and later drove him out; the prophetic mentions are comparisons and figures of speech.

clauses.english: was where the LORD God planted a garden and put the man he had formed
clauses.quote: the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed

clauses.english: was where the man was driven out, with cherubims and a flaming sword set to keep the way of the tree of life
clauses.quote: he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way

doubts: The mentions in Isaiah 51:3, Ezekiel 28:13, 31:9, 31:16, 31:18, 36:35 and Joel 2:3 are comparisons or figures of speech, so they were left out.
GEN 4:16 only places Nod east of Eden, so it was not used.
